The packaged standard-library code gives independent matching-enumeration and vertex-subset deletion counts (36 matchings; 435 pair counts) and checks every entry of exact integer equations Q^2=24Q and BQ=0 and tr Q=240. Symmetry and incidence rank then establish C=(2/3)Pi_ker B without numeric approximations. The line graph adjacency identity and finite-volume Gibbs fluctuation-dissipation formula give the claimed flat-band relation and Curie coefficient. A finite exhaustive certificate suffices because the graph is fixed; no untested extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The full site-resolved response is a motivated physical invariant of the magnetization plateau in a canonical frustrated molecular cluster. Exact isotropy in the ten allowed fluctuation directions and equivalence to the ten-dimensional one-magnon flat-band subspace are additional structure not implied by the established 36 state and ten mode counts. The complete 435-pair pinning classification records geometrically varying cooperative and antagonistic responses and gives a precise tool for studying site-selective plateau probes.
